reason: A WeCom intelligent robot integration that relays private or group chat messages to DSH agents and returns task results, with workspace/session controls and approval handling through chat.

summaries.zh: 通过企业微信智能机器人接收私聊或群聊任务，交由 DSH agent 执行并将结果回传，同时支持会话、工作区和审批交互。
summaries.en: Connects a WeCom intelligent robot to DSH agents so chat tasks can be executed and results, workspace controls, and approval interactions can be returned through WeCom.

capabilities: Maintains a WebSocket connection to the WeCom intelligent robot service
Receives private and group chat messages and submits them as tasks to DSH agents
Returns agent responses to WeCom conversations, including streamed updates
Supports per-user agent sessions, workspace switching, and persistent working-directory selection
Forwards agent permission approval requests to WeCom and accepts approval or rejection replies
May enable DSH agent tools such as command execution and filesystem operations according to the configured preset
